title: Ἀνθολόγιον / Anthology (Eclogae and Florilegium) / «Антология» Стобея; unit: Book IV, chs. 22–25 (marriage, household, children)
author: Ioannes Stobaeus
language: Ancient Greek (prose and verse excerpts in many dialects)
size: 4 books; Wachsmuth–Hense 5 vols (about 2,500 pp.). Unit estimate 15–20k words.
edition: C. Wachsmuth & O. Hense, Berlin 1884–1912 (PD; archive.org).
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Стобей): 'не переведена ни на один современный язык'. Only Anth. IV.7 (Наставления о царской власти, Исторический вестник 26, 2018, pp. 280–306) and scattered fragments in collections.
en_evidence: en.wikipedia (Stobaeus): 'The entire work has not been translated into any modern language'. Only excerpted authors are translated (Hermetica, Arius Didymus, Pythagorean pseudepigrapha).
other_translations: No complete translation. Partial versions only within editions of the source authors.
value: Preserves hundreds of otherwise lost texts: tragedy, comedy, Presocratics, Stoics, Hierocles, Pythagorean treatises. Read as whole chapters, it shows late-antique thematic ethics. Valuable for history of philosophy, gender and the family.
ai_feasibility: medium-high: many short excerpts. Verse fragments, Doric pseudepigrapha, attribution and textual problems need expert review.
pilot_unit: IV.22 Περὶ γάμου (On marriage). Estimate 8–10k words.
